wizard.reference_ftir.provider.definition: The provider determines how the project interprets the incoming FTIR reference file family.

wizard.reference_ftir.role.label: Role
wizard.reference_ftir.role.short_description: Declares whether the FTIR stream is being used as audit evidence or a general reference stream.

wizard.reference_ftir.file_pattern.short_description: Limits which FTIR files are included when the configured path points at a folder.

wizard.reference_ftir.freshness_s.label: Freshness (s)
wizard.reference_ftir.freshness_s.short_description: Defines how stale an FTIR file update may be before the ingest path considers it out of date.
wizard.reference_ftir.freshness_s.definition: Freshness is the allowable age threshold for the active FTIR file update stream.
wizard.reference_ftir.freshness_s.process_note: Use a short threshold for live audit/reference use so stale FTIR files are not mistaken for current evidence.

runner.ftir.enable_package.label: Enable FTIR validation package
runner.ftir.enable_package.short_description: Turns on the FTIR side-by-side validation package inside the formal Report Builder.
